header.running_head: 2. Doing Deeds for the Pleasure of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: اِحْدَي بَنَاتِهِ وَعِنْدَهُ سَعْدٌ واُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَمُعَاذٌ ﵃ اَنَّ ابْنَهَا يَجُوْدُ بِنَفْسِهِ فَبَعَثَ اِلَيْهَا: لِلّهِ مَا اَخَذَ، وَلِلّهِ مَا اَعْطَي، كُلٌّ بِاَجَلٍ، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب وكان امر الله قدرا مقدورا، رقم:٦٦٠٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Usamah (RA) narrates, “When I, Hazrat Sa'd, Hazrat Ubayy ibn Ka'b and Hazrat Mu'adh (RA) were in the gathering of the Prophet ﷺ, a man came and told the news, “The child of one of the daughters of the Prophet ﷺ is at the point of death.”“What Allah Ta'ala has taken belongs to Him! What He gave us also belongs to Him! With Him a time is fixed for everything. So, adopt patience. And hope from Allah that, by adopting patience over this affliction, the rewards promised by Allah Ta'ala will be received,” the Prophet ﷺ sent word to his daughter through the man who had come.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِنِسْوَةٍ مِنَ اْلاَنْصَارِ: لَا يَمُوْتُ لِإِحْدَاكُنَّ ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنَ الْوَلَدِ فَتَحْتَسِبَهُ، اِلَّا دَخَلَتِ الْجَنَّةَ، فَقَالَتِ امْرَاَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ: اَوِ اثْنَانِ؟ يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ! قَالَ: اَوِ اثْنَانِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب فضل من يموت له ولد فيحتسبه، رقم:٦٦٩٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that when the Prophet ﷺ said to the women of the Ansar, “If three children of any one of you die and she hopes for the reward from Allah Ta'ala, she will surely go to Jannah,” one woman among them asked, “O Rasulullah, if two children die?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “ Even if two children die, the same reward will be received.”
